description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy' that manages HTML cleanup modules related to tidying HTML content. It includes properties for levels of fixes, methods for setting up fixes based on configuration, retrieving fixes for specific levels, populating fixes, and identifying fix types.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy
classes.description: An abstract class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that manages HTML cleanup fixes, levels, and their application for tidying HTML content.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by determining necessary fixes based on provided configuration, and applies them through populate().

methods.name: getFixesForLevel
methods.description: Returns a set of fixes applicable for a specified level and below, based on the module's levels.

methods.name: makeFixesForLevel
methods.description: Populates the fixesForLevel property with fixes corresponding to a default level, used for dynamic level-based fix application.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Assigns specific fixes to the module based on an input array, configuring necessary transformations and operations.

methods.name: getFixType
methods.description: Parses a fix name string to determine its type and associated parameters for processing.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Defines and returns an array of available fixes for the module; meant to be overridden for specific fix implementations.
